implementation: One shared prospective-design policy included by design_requirements, consumed by synthesis, repair and semantic verification.
changes: Choose explicit prospective settings rather than postponing design decisions.
Dataset scope/capacity and existing assets remain evidence-bound facts.
A fixed seeded random split is not inherently contradictory; seed purpose and executable procedure remain required.
A grounded complete dataset selection does not require an unnecessary name list.
Future checkpoint identity is recorded at execution; an executable acquisition/training and pairing rule is required now, not an invented hash or a proposed filename alone.
Accepted concrete choices constrain repairs; missing details must still be filled in allowed revision targets.
Correct every_nth schema example to use offset, describing zero-based indexing outside the field name.

qoder.scope: Three source files only; tools disabled; no papers, runtime data or secrets.
qoder.integration: Manually reviewed; did not apply its malformed duplicate data-role diff or accept a proposed checkpoint label as sufficient.
